name: Bangla Human & AI Text Classification Dataset
description: A balanced dataset of 6,000 Bengali text samples (3,000 human-written and 3,000 AI-generated) designed for binary classification of synthetic and natural human writing in Bengali. Each sample includes source text, binary label, and character/word length metadata.

size.notes: 6,000 balanced records across human and AI text classes.

provenance.collection_method: Human texts scraped and extracted from Bengali content; AI texts synthesized using generative language models.
provenance.curation_notes: Balanced 3,000 human and 3,000 AI samples formatted with token length statistics.
